text:
Iris D.: quick heads-up: opened a small PR to trim duplicated long examples and unify SDK snippets to the action-response envelope. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342. need a fast sanity pass on snippets and anchors.
Marco G.: on it. which docs are moving vs staying?
Iris D.: moving long_examples.md -> examples/extended/long_examples.md and leaving a tiny canonical page at guides/structured-output/index.md. will add redirect anchors on the old page.
Leah P.: sounds good. paste of the canonical snippet i'm keeping (will be the one in the guide):
```json
{
  "action": "check_subscription",
  "args": { "user_id": "u_77" },
  "response": { "status": "ok", "payload": null }
}
```
Leah P.: one editorial note: add one sentence explaining payload: null means "no resource" (like HTTP 204) so SDKs shouldn't treat it as an error.
Marco G.: also flagging SDK naming diffs: older libs used invoke/tool_call. i'll grep for "invoke(" and propose replacements where callAction exists. avoid blind mass replace.
ci-bot: link-checker: 5 broken links detected in docs/guides/structured-output (CI job #2891).
Iris D.: thanks bot. another render blocker we've hit before: Hugo drops leading spaces on triple-backtick blocks. please remove any indentation before merging.
Leah P.: i'll run markdown-lint + hugo preview now and push fixes if needed.
ci-bot: docs-build: preview available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5342. link-checker: 0 failures after fixes.
Iris D.: merged. :tada: thanks all.
l10n-bot: note: moved anchors may affect translations, creating redirects in examples/extended should help.
Iris D.: added a short migration blurb to /guides/migration mapping invoke -> callAction (js), call_action (py), see examples/extended/interop.md for language adapters.
